title: Anthropic Adjusts Claude Code Usage Limits: Basic Quota Permanently Increased by 25%, Actual Weekly Cap Reduced by 17%
excerpt: On August 30, the AI startup Anthropic confirmed through its official X account that it will adjust the usage limits for its AI code assistant, Claude Code. Sta
content_html:
On August 30, the AI startup Anthropic confirmed through its official X account that it will adjust the usage limits for its AI code assistant, Claude Code. Starting on September 14 of the same year, the basic weekly usage limits for paid plans such as Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise will be permanently increased by 25% compared to the previous level.

However, since the current temporary 50% usage increase policy will end on September 14, this rule update actually means that users' weekly quotas in the future will be 17% less than the current temporary limit. Anthropic stated that it is continuously improving the experience, aiming to provide users with greater returns, while enhancing transparency and user control over their usage.

At the same time, Anthropic has recently introduced a series of technical iterations and functional upgrades for Claude Code, including key improvements in underlying performance and the introduction of an automated feedback mechanism. When the system encounters issues, the tool can automatically generate error reports containing session logs, which users can choose to enable or disable in the settings and submit manually, thereby improving product troubleshooting efficiency.

As generative AI becomes more deeply integrated into software development, it has become a common trend for model service providers to balance the expansion of computing resources with cost optimization. By adjusting usage limits and optimizing performance and feedback tools, Anthropic demonstrates that AI code assistance services are accelerating their transition from early-scale expansion to precise computing power operations. This shift may further impact pricing and service supply structures in the developer tools market in the future.
